name: Hayami Asagao
source: Out of all of the characters in the story, Hayami Asagao is probably the most hardworking and intelligent.  She finds solace in her work, which typically consists of programming. Having proven herself from the creation of a successful app for the Orca card, Asagao is the backbone of the Cocoro Function Countermeasure Committee. Her true potential is clouded by her depressive nature, which is slowly addressed and dynamically aided throughout the story.
